title: Asset Intake Wizard, Map Composer, Palette & Workbench

intake_wizard.source_scope: Only user-supplied or already-catalogued source/package/asset evidence and completed MAI-06 import results enter the wizard; no provider network ingestion, download, purchase, authentication, scraping, payment or automatic acquisition.
intake_wizard.validation_rule: Required source/checksum/license/provenance/import evidence remains explicit; unsupported, malformed, denied, unknown or unverified inputs produce stable findings and cannot be silently normalized into allowed assets.

palette.selection_rule: Selectable candidates remain MAI-07 eligible; denied, unknown, incompatible and unverified candidates remain visible evidence but non-authorizing.
palette.manual_rule: Manual assignment/override is first-class; missing or ineligible manual requests remain visibly unresolved rather than silently falling back.
palette.placeholder_rule: Approved placeholders remain explicit and must themselves be permitted.

composer.reversibility_rule: Layer, placeable and assignment operations mutate draft presentation state only and are reversible without rewriting source evidence or owner-domain state.
composer.owner_rule: Draft output cannot create or mutate canonical World/location/topology/navigation, runtime Scene state, visibility/occlusion authorization, collision/cover/movement/combat/interaction state or D29 publication state.

save_boundary.rule: Export canonicalizes draft evidence/state and produces a deterministic draft receipt for later MAI-09 integration only.
save_boundary.persistence: No durable database schema delta was demonstrated; migration 0022 remains unreserved.

preserved_boundaries: no vendor/editor/provider becomes canonical Multiversal map truth
no asset pack is assumed complete
semantic requirements remain separate from selected/available art
permissions and semantic compatibility are not inferred
manual assignment, approved-placeholder and visibly-unresolved outcomes remain first-class and reversible
intake is supplied/catalogued evidence only with no automatic provider acquisition
composer/workbench output remains presentation-authoring draft state only
MIB-11/D18, D29, Scene/Tabletop, Visibility/Permissions and Combat/Exploration retain owner truth
MAI-09 may be selected_not_started only after this completion
no real-money commerce, tester distribution, release/deployment or provider/payment activation
completion_rule: Exact head passed the focused MAI-08 verifier, client typecheck/integration regression, MAI-07..01 predecessor and MIB-11 owner regressions, exact-head Repository Health, the complete self-hosted Linux/Windows Validation Core workflow and deterministic cross-platform comparison before squash merge. No repair cycle was required.
nonauthorization: migration 0022 without demonstrated durable schema delta
next_action: MAI-08 is completed_verified with no further implementation authority. MAI-09 may be selected_not_started only; a future owner Continue must freshly verify canonical heads, re-read completed MAI-01..08 and owner contracts, and governed-start MAI-09 before integration implementation.
